description:
Role: RPA Developer (WorkFusion, Blue Prism, Automation Anywhere)
Location: Frisco TX
Duration: Fulltime

BGV will be done for the selected candidates.


Job Title : RPA developer (WorkFusion, Blue Prism, Automation Anywhere- Should be Expert on any one tools )

Experience: 3-8 Years with at least 2 years in RPA development


· Hands on experience in developing and implementing automations using WorkFusion / Blue Prism as an accredited developer.

· Good working knowledge and understanding of the RPA/Cognitive tool vendors, tool capabilities, features and functionalities.

· Ability to analyze customer requirements and provide automation solutions

· Good professional English communication ( written and spoken ) skills

· Candidate should have experience in 2 or more of automation tools E.g., not limiting to – WorkFusion, Blue Prism, Automation Anywhere and Pega Robotics

· Candidate should have knowledge of various open source technologies for versioning management and automation.

· Experience creating and demonstrating POCs to clients

Tools and Knowledge:

Mandatory

· Expert knowledge of 2 or more of - 

o WorkFusion

o Blue Prism,

o Automation Anywhere,

o Pega Rebotics &

o UIPath

· Programming and Scripting Languages like Shell Script/Perl/VB Script/Java Scripting/Power Shell , .NET and Advanced Java

· DB Knowledge like Oracle/MS SQL/MySQL

Optional (Desirable / Awareness)

· Cognitive / AI Tools like IBM Watson, Arago, inSTREAM, IP Soft Amelia
· Good understanding of enabling IT Infrastructure including virtual farms, network and security.
